De : Nat Kao <nat@example.org>
Envoyé : vendredi 3 juillet 2026 04:16
À : BOUCADAIR Mohamed <med@example.org>
Objet : Re: review of draft-ietf-wg-example

Hi Med,

Many thanks for the review. Please see our responses below.

# Consider adding a pointer to the registry cited here in the introduction

Updated as suggested, with a pointer to the IANA registry group.
[Med] ACK

# Early allocation is mentioned but the policy text is outdated now

Updated. We have added a reference to the policy document as well.
[Med] I think this can be simplified further by citing the policy document alone.

Regards,
Nat
